question: Can strictly prior completed oil-session context route the high-cadence macro auction into acceptance continuation and failed-auction reversal without destroying ordinary one-to-several-event cadence?

windows.validation_law: event counts and causal labels only; no validation return, MFE, MAE, PnL, or selection

source_event.signal: completed matched-month CL five-minute raw turn
source_event.transport_confirmation: same-suffix completed-five-minute MCL close move has the raw-turn sign
source_event.context_warmup: 94 strictly prior finalized matched-month CL Globex sessions
source_event.position_count_owner: start flat after warmup, split, and every contract suffix; count only a routed direction change

context.causal_cutoff: bisect strictly before the event's Globex trading-session date; current-session bars never enter context
context.daily_bar: completed common-tape CL Globex OHLC only; require an observed 18:01-18:05 ET open and at least 16:55 ET close
context.math: reuse the centralized multihorizon return, normalized velocity/acceleration, TR phase, drawdown, transition, and age law from xsp_opening_edge_state; do not reuse XSP session or admission policy

declared_profiles.four_horizon_majority: fade the raw auction only when at least three of 5/21/63/84-session directions oppose it; ties preserve raw direction
declared_profiles.soft_fast_consensus: 5/21-session consensus owns a fade only when both oppose raw; disagreement or alignment preserves raw
declared_profiles.mid_hard_consensus: 63/84-session consensus owns a fade only when both oppose raw; disagreement or alignment preserves raw

count_gates_each_profile_each_period.density: median 1-3, p95 <=6, maximum <=10 entries per active session

successor_law: Only count-qualified frozen profiles may enter one separately preregistered discovery-first lifecycle. That lifecycle may rank the declared profiles from discovery economics, but validation remains sealed until its selected profile passes unchanged after-cost, direction, branch, lane, month, quarter, concentration, and PnL/DD gates.

hard_limits.missing_july_2023_to_august_2024: hard crown blocker and source of discovery warmup truncation
hard_limits.private_context_reuse: research-only; a passing candidate requires a separate decision before any generic production extraction
